verdicts.reason: Both are 320x50 crops of the photo with the 'Perfect Taste' lockup shrunk to a tiny two-line stack. The gold leaf wreath is effectively lost, and the fig is cropped into unreadable fragments, so neither reads as a left-to-right banner. A's title is slightly larger and sits on a clear centre axis, while B's is smaller, set off-centre at an arbitrary spot, harder to read against the busy blurred background, and leaves the right half to cropped fruit.
